bug_semantics: Stored cross-site scripting in Telegram message search results: an attacker who can post to a shared Telegram group can store markup such as as message content. The application persists that content and later passes item.content to highlightKeyword(), which returned the raw text with only matching substrings wrapped in a span; Vue's v-html then assigned that attacker-controlled string as innerHTML. Merely rendering the result in another user's browser executes the handler. The closing change HTML-escapes message text before adding the intended highlight markup and also HTML/regex-escapes the keyword.
flaw_origin: The smallest first-writer is decomposed PR #145 member 6454fcaf810d2cd92d9010dffc6b14b3acfa0ad7 ('feat: global search', 2025-05-09). It created apps/frontend/src/components/GlobalSearch.vue, including highlightKeyword(text, keyword), the unescaped return text.replace(regex, '$1'), and v-html="highlightKeyword(item.content, keyword)". The mainline commit 4fec95f79a6215d61e92f572baefef9379632d55 is the squash aggregate, not the BIC. Later commits renamed, extracted, copied, and moved the same mechanism through SearchDialog.vue, MessageList.vue, packages/stage-ui, and apps/web; those are not first introductions.
ai_marker: Absent on the BIC commit object. `git cat-file -p 6454fcaf810d2cd92d9010dffc6b14b3acfa0ad7` shows human author and committer `hahaqwq <hahaqwq233@gmail.com>` and the sole message `feat: global search`; it contains no Co-authored-by AI identity, Generated-with trailer, other AI attribution, or bot author/committer.
evidence: First-party issue https://github.com/groupultra/telegram-search/issues/653 identifies apps/web/src/components/messages/MessageList.vue, shows the attacker-message -> stored verbatim -> highlightKeyword -> v-html/innerHTML path, and gives an reproduction; PR https://github.com/groupultra/telegram-search/pull/654 describes and closes that issue. Squash decomposition is reproducible from https://api.github.com/repos/groupultra/telegram-search/pulls/145 and /pulls/145/commits: the API reports squash landing 4fec95f79a6215d61e92f572baefef9379632d55 and the nine ordered member SHAs recorded above; `git diff --exit-code 4fec95f79a6215d61e92f572baefef9379632d55 e710c48a23de208aee6f214879e7d345ec83f086` is empty, confirming the squash and PR head have identical trees. `git log -L '/function highlightKeyword/,/^}/':apps/frontend/src/components/GlobalSearch.vue 6454fcaf810d2cd92d9010dffc6b14b3acfa0ad7` attributes all six unsafe function lines to 6454fcaf810d2cd92d9010dffc6b14b3acfa0ad7; `git log -S'highlightKeyword' 6ee99f31d41b7574fef773343477e7c640c2af2f..6454fcaf810d2cd92d9010dffc6b14b3acfa0ad7 -- apps/frontend/src/components/GlobalSearch.vue` returns only that commit. Direct parent verification: `git ls-tree -r --name-only 6ee99f31d41b7574fef773343477e7c640c2af2f apps/frontend/src/components/GlobalSearch.vue` and `git grep -n -F highlightKeyword 6ee99f31d41b7574fef773343477e7c640c2af2f` both produce no match. Lifecycle checks: 1221e8cbb3337ffabe0712d9d4491ff6af3c2dbd is an R100 GlobalSearch.vue -> SearchDialog.vue rename; f06dcba73f5b4cee3649806fa47484d4acf379a3 extracts the unsafe function/sink into MessageList.vue; 546674c43bd97822c318d04b44726bbd62c1872c moves the UI to packages/stage-ui; f550795c684660ef8f58ffe48e9d567ea12cac52 is an R100 move to apps/web. Tag boundary from `git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/groupultra/telegram-search.git` plus object inspection: preceding v0.0.10 peels to 4dc33becac58dfd5d179447c9fb179f82625d03d and has no highlightKeyword; first affected v1.0.0-beta.1 points to 06cc11e4ebb250807b0d59c5a3bfb13fc00d16a1, contains 4fec95f7 by `git merge-base --is-ancestor`, and `git grep` finds the unsafe v-html sink. Last pre-fix tag v1.2.8 peels to 34a815af8486543d40fd05bd9bd29788c062b7e7 and still contains `return text.replace(regex, ...)`; the first later tag is v1.3.1, peeling to 6a2909429e180bd6d4f79c46a882585f5f89bbc1, which contains `const safe = escapeHtml(text)` and has 54f6adced844ce9990228d75e31348bfed934e05 as an ancestor. `git show 40155a70764e85ddf995ea3ce11a7671b9a6ef9b` shows the original 13-line security patch; the PR branch then merged main and autofix-ci adjusted one line, and `git diff --exit-code d97c140765afd57f56471fcc1e8f2e4c06f9ec39 54f6adced844ce9990228d75e31348bfed934e05 -- apps/web/src/components/messages/MessageList.vue` is empty, proving landed fix 54f6adce matches the final reviewed PR content.
reasoning: The vulnerability is established independently from the first-party report and the source/history: raw, persistent cross-user Telegram content reaches a Vue innerHTML sink without neutralization. Mainline 4fec95f7 is a nine-commit GitHub squash; decomposing PR #145 makes 6454fcaf the atomic member that first created both the unsafe transformer and its v-html sink, while its immediate parent has neither the file nor the symbol. Subsequent exact renames, extraction, copies, and directory migrations preserve the flaw and therefore cannot replace the BIC. The unsafe behavior ships from v1.0.0-beta.1 through v1.2.8; landed commit 54f6adce closes it and v1.3.1 is the first subsequent tag containing the escape. AI attribution is judged only from the decomposed BIC object, whose human author/committer and trailer-free message provide no qualifying AI evidence, so the closed result is NOT_AI.
